title: The EXPLORE MG Registry for Myasthenia Gravis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to create a Yale University Department of Neurology Myasthenia Gravis (MG) registry that will be used for current and future research projects involving the study of Myasthenia Gravis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients diagnosed with Myasthenia Gravis presenting to the Yale Department of Neurology for clinical care or research interventions will be invited to donate their biological specimens/clinical data.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Failure to meet the Inclusion Criteria.
study_population: Subjects will be 18 years of age or older with a clinical diagnosis of a Myasthenia Gravis.
